about: r24: Kevy's duel soundtrack. Each duel picks one track at random (never the same twice in a row), fades it in, and loops it by crossfading into itself just before its natural ending (end, in seconds). A new duel crossfades to a new track. Remove all tracks to use the built-in score.
credit: Duel soundtrack: original tracks by Kevy, made with Suno (21 Oct 2026).
